test_GTestHelpTest: test the GTestHelpTest class to verify gtest help flag behavior with various flag variants
run_RUNWithFlag: run the gtest_help_test_ binary with a given command-line flag and capture exit code and output
test_TestHelpFlag: test that the help message is printed correctly when a help flag like --help or -h is specified

review_HELP_REGEX: review the HELP_REGEX pattern that validates gtest help output contains all expected flag descriptions
